These identities give all four phase-conditional covariances and the +/- delta^2 phase-mean terms, including t=0 odd. A>0 follows 1-3r+3r^2>=1/4, and lag-one positivity follows A/2>=1/(96 beta^2)>delta^2. Independently integrated A exactly for beta=3/2,4/3,7/3. This analytic proof covers all admissible p,q,k and t, not just the ten finite checker cases. Boundaries r=0 and q=1 are explicitly excluded; zero-lag variance uses law of total variance.
